title: Best OP Auto Answer Zero Anxiety ESP Fly No Clip
features:
Ronix Hub - Cheating During Testing

Auto Test
- Auto Answer clicks answer 1 to 4 for you, or a random one each question
- Only runs while a test is in progress, with a Delay slider from 0 to 5 seconds
- Click Answer 1, 2, 3 and 4 buttons to answer by hand straight from the menu

Stats
- Zero Anxiety toggle, plus an Anxiety Amount slider with an Apply button
- Player Effects: No Death, God Mode and No Tool Lock toggles, all off by default

Shop
- Buy Phones, SmartWatch, Pen, Eraser, Glasses or Snitch from a dropdown
- Set the phone answer slot and SmartWatch color, or use Buy All Tools in one press
- Save Data: a Permanent Save button that buys the save for your credits and items

Teleport
- Classroom, Lobby, Nearest Desk and My Desk teleport buttons
- TP to Player dropdown that refreshes the player list every 3 seconds

Visual
- ESP name tags on players, boxes on every desk seat and a glow on tools
- Effects: No Camera Shake, No Teacher Vision and No Anxiety Effect toggles

Movement
- Walk Speed and Jump Power up to 200, Fly with a speed slider, No Clip

Info
- Live test phase, credits, grade, level, anxiety, eraser uses and players

Settings
- Anti AFK on by default, test and shop notifications, Rejoin Server
- FPS Boost, No Shadows, No Particles, No GUI and a Copy Place ID button

Mobile friendly. Join discord.gg/ronixstudios for support and updates.
